item.description: Here's your Woodchuck Weather. High temperatures today will range from forty-seven to fifty-two degrees, with lows tonight between thirty-four and thirty-eight across the region. Expect mostly cloudy to overcast skies with periods of rain likely throughout the day and night, and precipitation chances ranging from thirty to over ninety percent. Rainfall amounts will generally stay under a half inch, with the heaviest expected early, then lingering showers into tonight.
